raw_segments.text: Now, to be sure, if anything else is a gift of the gods to men, it is probable that happiness
is a gift of theirs too, and specially because of all human goods it is the highest.
But this, it may be, is a question belonging more properly to an investigation different
And it is quite clear that on the supposition of its not being sent from the gods direct,
but coming to us by reason of virtue and learning of a certain kind or discipline, it is yet
one of the most godlike things, because the prize and end of virtue is manifestly somewhat
most excellent, nay divine and blessed.
